NPC_EARTHQUAKE: Shakes the ground, damaging every enemy on screen. The damage is split between all the targets hit.
NPC_DRAGONFEAR: Terrifying roar that may inflict Stun, Bleeding, Curse or Silence on every enemy on screen.
NPC_PULSESTRIKE: Shockwave that blasts every enemy around the caster and hurls them backwards.
NPC_HELLJUDGEMENT: Calls down a judgement that strikes every enemy on screen.
NPC_WIDESILENCE: Inflicts Silence on every enemy on screen.
NPC_WIDEBLEEDING: Inflicts Bleeding on every enemy on screen.
NPC_WIDESTONE: Turns every enemy on screen to stone.
NPC_WIDECONFUSE: Inflicts Confusion on every enemy on screen.
NPC_WIDESLEEP: Puts every enemy on screen to Sleep.
NPC_WIDECURSE: Inflicts Curse on every enemy on screen.
NPC_EVILLAND: Lays down cursed ground that damages the living and heals Undead property targets standing on it.
NPC_MAGICMIRROR: Reflects the magic cast at the caster back onto its caster.
NPC_SLOWCAST: Doubles the casting time of every enemy on screen.
NPC_CRITICALWOUND: Attack that halves the healing the target receives for a while.
NPC_STONESKIN: Sharply raises the caster's DEF while lowering its MDEF.
NPC_ANTIMAGIC: Sharply raises the caster's MDEF while lowering its DEF.
NPC_VAMPIRE_GIFT: Drains the HP of every enemy around the caster and heals the caster with it.
NPC_WIDESOULDRAIN: Drains the SP of every enemy on screen.
NPC_HELLPOWER: Curses the target so that it cannot be resurrected, and blocks the Token of Siegfried.
NPC_ALLHEAL: Restores the caster's HP to full.
ALL_ANGEL_PROTECT: Event blessing that shields the target from harm.
ALL_REVERSEORCISH: Cancels the Orc Head transformation and returns the character to normal.
ALL_ODINS_RECALL: Warps the caster back to the Odin Shrine.
GD_ITEMEMERGENCYCALL: Guild skill. Summons every guild member on the map to the caster, using an item instead of the usual cooldown.
